rules.statement: A cestui que trust can sue a trustee to recover a specific sum of money due under the trust, even if no accounts have been taken.
rules.supporting_quote: "The action is one brought by a cestui que trust to recover a sum of money due him under the trust from the trustee. The plaintiff alleges that a certain definite sum is in the defendant's hands, and if he has proved what he alleged, I cannot see any obstacle whatever to his recovering it in this suit"
